messages.author: 8bd77e2bddff37f3
messages.subject: mirtCAT Login
parts:
Hi Phil,

in the current version of mirtCAT you have to restart the test if you entered the wrong password/login. I was wondering if it would be possible to give the test persons a new login attempt without restarting the test?

I am asking because we are administering a mirtCAT test through the safe exam browser (puts the computer into a kiosk mode). If a test person enters the wrong password/login the administrator has to close the safe exam browser manually (because only he knows the exit key) and restart the test.

Thanks!
Aron

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: mirtCAT Login
parts:
Hi Aron,

This is a very reasonable request. I've added this feature to the dev version (1.9.7), where users now have up to 3 total attempts to get the password right. A counter is also included so they are aware how many attempts are left (see the screenshot below, which is now printed when the first password fails). I don't see the need in exposing this internal component to the user (who needs more than 3 attempts at a password?), so hopefully this is sufficient for your needs. Cheers.



Phil

parts:
Hi Phil,

thanks for the quick implementation. Eveyrthing works well if I just use a password. If I use different combinations of login names and passwords I have only one attempt. When the first attempt is wrong it shows the error you mentioned above. When I try to put in a new login name afterwards it changes to "Login Name/Password were incorrect. Please restart the application and try again."as soon as i put in the first letter, without even pressing the next button. I attached a minimal example.

Cheers
Aron
